newsitem.title: USA: Angeion nets sales from Sentinel product.
newsitem.headline: Angeion nets sales from Sentinel product.

text.p: Angeion Corp said Monday it earned net sales of $2,948,729 in fiscal 1996 related to its Sentinel Series of implantable cardioverter defibrillator systems.
The company had no sales in fiscal 1995.

Angeion said the sales were primarily derived from original equipment manufacturer sales to Pacesetter Inc, a unit of St. Jude Medical Inc, as well as sales from its European and U.S. clinical studies.

Earlier, Angeion, which develops medical devices for treating irregular heartbeats, reported a net loss for the fourth quarter ended July 31 of $0.20 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.17. Its loss for fiscal 1996 was $0.66 a share, compared with a loss of $0.58 a year ago.
Angeion said its losses were due to operating expenses related primarily to research, development and manufacturing.
